source_text:
3.5 Ἀφρικανοῦ· πρὸς <τὸ> πολλὰ καὶ ἀπόνως ἀφροδισιάζειν Σκίγκου τὰ
κρέα ἐν οἴνῳ κεκραμένῳ δεῖ τὸ ζῷον ἐγχυματίζειν.
pass_a_gloss: 3.5 Of-Africanus: toward the many and without-toil to-have-aphrodisia. Of-a-skink the meats in wine mixed one-must the animal to-drench.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus: toward having intercourse much and without toil. One must drench the animal with the meats of a skink in mixed wine.

choices.why: ἐγχυματίζειν is a liquid drench of the beast, not smearing the meat as a salve.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
